homeTitle: SyNERDgy Solutions LLC | Systems Consulting, Operational Intelligence & Applied R&D
homeDescription: SyNERDgy Solutions LLC is a Lexington, Kentucky systems and operations consulting firm providing workflow optimization, operational diagnostics, compliance and governance analysis, implementation support, and applied R&D.
organizationDescription: SyNERDgy Solutions LLC is a Lexington, Kentucky systems consulting, operational intelligence, and applied research firm. We diagnose complex operating problems, reconstruct workflows, trace root causes and dependencies, map legal and compliance constraints, strengthen governance and records, and design implementation-ready interventions.

serviceCatalog.name: Systems & Operations Consulting
serviceCatalog.description: Diagnose fragmented operating systems, clarify ownership and dependencies, redesign workflows, and support implementation.

serviceCatalog.name: Workflow Optimization & Process Rebuilding
serviceCatalog.serviceType: Workflow optimization and business process improvement
serviceCatalog.description: Map current-state work, identify bottlenecks and failure points, rebuild task paths and controls, and create implementation-ready processes.

serviceCatalog.name: Operational Diagnostics
serviceCatalog.description: Trace symptoms to underlying structural causes across people, process, requirements, records, technology, ownership, and handoffs.

serviceCatalog.name: Governance, Compliance & Regulatory Analysis
serviceCatalog.description: Identify applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, policy, and program constraints and stress-test proposed interventions against them.

serviceCatalog.name: Regulatory & Program Studies
serviceCatalog.description: Research authority, reconstruct how programs operate, gather evidence, develop findings, and produce practical recommendations.

serviceCatalog.name: Corrective-Action & Implementation Support
serviceCatalog.description: Turn findings into assigned actions, controls, evidence requirements, progress tracking, escalation paths, and verified closure.

serviceCatalog.name: Evidence, Records & Document Control
serviceCatalog.description: Build records and evidence structures that preserve decisions, requirements, approvals, ownership, and auditability.

serviceCatalog.name: Administrative Surge & Continuity Support
serviceCatalog.description: Stabilize intake, backlog, reporting, records, status tracking, and operational handoffs during overload or disruption.

serviceCatalog.name: Prime & Subcontract Workstream Support
serviceCatalog.description: Provide research, technical writing, document control, project operations, workflow design, and specialized analysis for defined workstreams.

serviceCatalog.name: Applied R&D & Operational Intelligence
serviceCatalog.description: Study complex real-world systems, identify reusable patterns, stress-test methods, and develop practical diagnostic and decision-support approaches.
